policy.gate: Confirm canonical Place records, canonical Place Storage targets, and bounded Place projections before generation output is integrated or uploaded.
prohibitions: Do not use Dish photographs as Place media.
Do not generate, trace, redraw, approximate, or spell a logo or wordmark.
Do not generate letters, words, menu copy, prices, slogans, or extra identity bars.
Do not copy generated images into landing scenes, Kitchen assets, Dish records, or App runtime identity paths.
Do not present concept imagery as a photograph of an operating venue.

crop_safe.notes: Primary venue read and any clean sign panel remain inside the central 70%.
Primary venue read remains within the central 60%; perimeter may crop on responsive cards.
The named operational subject remains inside the central 76%.

style: Plausible Swiss fast-casual venue construction, equipment, circulation, lighting, and food-safety layout.
Natural lens perspective, coherent scale, realistic materials, restrained commercial lighting, and believable wear.
No people as the primary subject; incidental staff or guests may appear only as natural environmental context.
No isolated plated food, hero Dish composition, macro food photography, floating products, or packaging close-up.
identity: Reserve clean, flat, front-facing sign panels wherever signage is compositionally useful.
Sign panels must be blank and free of glyphs, fake lettering, pseudo-writing, logos, wordmarks, icons, stripes, and bar marks.
Canonical identity artwork is applied only after generation in a separate compositing pass.
Do not infer brand spelling from the venue name supplied in production metadata.
technical: No baked-in border, frame, watermark, caption, UI, QR code, menu text, or legible screen content.
No clipped architecture, impossible reflections, duplicated fixtures, fused equipment, warped counters, or inaccessible circulation.
Keep primary subjects and reserved sign panels within the declared crop-safe area.
Generate the master aspect ratio directly; do not stretch or pad another aspect ratio.

visual_direction.character: compact Swiss fries venue; direct, warm, durable, operationally credible
visual_direction.identity_source_note: Use existing canonical Friiites identity artwork only during the later compositing pass; exactly three identity bars remain an artwork rule, never an image-generation instruction.

assets.subject: venue overview
assets.prompt: Square eye-level overview of a compact Swiss fast-casual fries venue from just inside the entrance, showing the counter, circulation, warm cream and near-black interior materials, subtle fry-gold accents, and a clean blank sign panel above the service counter. The image must read as a place, not as a food advertisement.

assets.subject: wide venue overview
assets.prompt: Wide 16:9 architectural view across the Friiites concept venue, showing the ordering side, counter, seating edge, and kitchen connection in one believable composition. Reserve a clean blank horizontal sign panel near the centre without lettering or bar marks. Keep the main counter and service opening inside the central crop-safe zone.

assets.subject: interior
assets.prompt: Square interior view of the Friiites concept venue showing seating, wall and floor finishes, lighting, counter edge, and customer circulation. Use near-black, warm cream, kraft timber, stainless steel, and restrained fry-gold details. Any wall identity location must be a clean blank panel with no generated marks.

assets.subject: four-kiosk ordering area
assets.prompt: Square view of one coherent ordering zone with exactly four self-service kiosks, evenly spaced and physically plausible, with accessible approach space, cable-safe installation, a queue lane, and the service counter visible in context. Kiosk screens show abstract non-legible interface blocks only. Reserve one blank sign panel; no generated brand text, logos, symbols, or extra bars.

assets.subject: preparation and kitchen
assets.prompt: Square documentary-style view into a compact fries preparation kitchen with credible stainless worktops, potato preparation area, sinks, cold holding, extraction, fry line, pass, washable surfaces, and clear staff circulation. The subject is the operational place and equipment; no plated Dish hero, branded packaging close-up, or legible labels.

visual_direction.character: compact smash-burger counter; energetic, functional, contemporary, operationally credible
visual_direction.identity_source_note: Preserve the existing Kitchen-owned Deanos logo as the only identity source for later compositing; image generation produces no lettering or identity geometry.

assets.subject: venue overview
assets.prompt: Square eye-level overview of a compact contemporary smash-burger venue, showing the ordering counter, open pass, customer circulation, charcoal metal, warm off-white tile, dark timber, stainless steel, and restrained coral-red accents. Reserve a clean blank sign panel above the counter. No burger or fries hero composition.

assets.subject: wide venue overview
assets.prompt: Wide 16:9 view across the Deanos concept venue, connecting the ordering area, counter, open pass, seating edge, and kitchen opening in one plausible fast-casual layout. Keep the operational counter and pass inside the central crop-safe zone. Include one clean blank sign panel with no writing or generated identity.

assets.subject: interior and counter
assets.prompt: Square interior view centred on the Deanos concept counter, showing menu-board mounting space, pickup edge, seating context, robust hospitality finishes, and believable circulation. Menu-board and identity panels remain blank with no pseudo-writing, logos, or symbols.

assets.subject: ordering area
assets.prompt: Square view of the Deanos concept ordering area with clear queue approach, counter ordering point, pickup distinction, accessible circulation, and one or two physically plausible self-service screens in environmental context. Screens use abstract non-legible interface blocks. All sign and menu panels remain blank.

assets.subject: kitchen and pass
assets.prompt: Square documentary-style view of the Deanos concept kitchen and service pass with a credible flat-top grill line, extraction, cold holding, stainless preparation benches, heat-lamp pass, washable surfaces, and clear staff circulation. The operational place and equipment are the subject; no isolated burger, fries, shake, or plated Dish hero.

replacement.note: The current five-image Dish-derived gallery contracts to the required three Place-owned gallery roles.

identity_compositing.timing: after image-generation QA and before runtime rendition approval
identity_compositing.source_rule: Use only the canonical identity artwork resolved after the Place migration; never use generated identity marks.
method: Apply identity artwork only to reserved sign panels with perspective and lighting matched to the scene.
Preserve the canonical artwork silhouette, spelling, spacing, bar count, colours, and clear space.
Do not alter the generated architecture outside the bounded sign panel during compositing.
Retain an unbranded generated master and a separate branded approval master; runtime files derive only from the approved branded master.

contract.pairing: matching canvas dimensions, aspect ratio, scale, visible bounds and internal padding
contract.vector_rule: retain an original approved vector master only when it genuinely exists and contains outlined paths
contract.same_file_rule: one file may satisfy both roles only with explicit designer confirmation

friiites.invariant: FR + exactly III + TES with the gold signature accent
friiites.current_place_wordmark: 1600x500 transparent PNG; usable on dark Place backdrop only; approval metadata and on-light counterpart remain blocked

deanos.classification_question: Determine whether the current burger lockup is an approved wordmark or a combined logo.
deanos.horizontal_requirement: If combined, require a dedicated approved horizontal wordmark for headers and wide Hero use.

prohibitions: No food photography, packaging variants or scene mockups at Level One

per_asset: Role, subject, aspect ratio, master dimensions, runtime dimensions, format, and sRGB profile match the manifest.
Named operational subject is visually dominant and remains inside the crop-safe coordinates.
No Dish photograph or Dish-derived crop is used as Place media.
No generated word, letter, logo, wordmark, pseudo-writing, QR code, menu price, or extra bar mark is visible.
Reserved sign panels are clean, planar, front-facing enough for later canonical artwork, and free of lighting discontinuities.
Architecture, reflections, furniture, kiosks, equipment, extraction, counters, hands, and people are anatomically and physically coherent.
No watermark, border, caption, UI frame, or baked-in concept label appears inside the image.
Concept status is carried by record/presentation metadata, not burned into the pixels.
friiites_specific: Ordering-area gallery contains exactly four kiosks.
The four kiosks are distinct, aligned, accessible, and not duplicated or fused.
Preparation gallery shows an operational kitchen context without becoming a fries or packaging hero image.
No generated attempt at Friiites spelling and no generated three-bar or extra-bar identity mark appears.
deanos_specific: All five outputs depict the parent venue rather than burgers, fries, shakes, or other Dish records.
Gallery resolves to exactly three roles in order: interior/counter, ordering area, kitchen/pass.
The kitchen/pass contains plausible smash-burger equipment and safe circulation without an isolated food hero.
No generated attempt at Deanos spelling or logo geometry appears.
handoff_gate: Canonical Place migration has completed and its read-back matrix identifies both Place records and exact owner-correct Storage targets.
Every runtime file has an approved master, checksum, dimensions, content type, concept-imagery status, and replacement decision.
Identity compositing has been approved against canonical artwork or explicitly omitted where no sign is required.
Replacement is create-or-replace only through the Place-owned mutation lane with a protected preimage and post-write projection verification.
No App, Kitchen, Dish, landing-scene, or packaging record is changed as part of the Place media replacement.
